# Fresh Library export input observer

This passive test-only fixture admits exactly Base2.1.24, MIR5.0.21017, the active-mod observer0.1.0, API Alpha0.1.0, API Beta0.1.0 and this observer0.1.0. It replaces the current fresh multiplayer observer only in a separately pinned prospective profile; it does not relabel its archive, R09 save, protected imported input, prior fixtures or native results.

The governed external actor provides real X11 input and may perform normal Library navigation outside this protocol. The observer records only six owned export-control clicks in order: English full settings, English compact settings, English Help diagnostics, then the same three German actions. It records the callback facts and reads the owned GUI tree on the following tick, after MIR's same-event handler. It never opens a browser, calls a remote interface, changes `player.opened` or GUI text, raises events, reads MIR storage, writes research/queue state, or creates a GUI element.

After both named EN/DE clients join, `00-baseline.json` records the bounded native fresh frame: the shared player force, settled Gear level/productivity owner, empty current/queue/progress and worker-storage modifier. Every action must retain that frame. Each later immutable role-local phase receipt binds the exact sorted six-mod identity, action/role/control path, MIRSET1 preview, and the expected settings-profile bytes. Diagnostics additionally bind the public diagnostic-preview text and expected `mir.log` bytes. The caller, not this fixture, reads and hashes actual role-local script-output files against those facts.

This observer is an input/export preparation only. It does not prove desktop delivery, screenshot correctness, personal-view behavior, API acceptance, a save/reload, imported-save preservation, performance, release qualification or stable acceptance. The retained R09 English initial/settled image occlusion remains a separate visual gap; this fixture does not introduce a popup preference or modify that source input.
